subject: Discovery recap & procurement framing — Novaforge
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@novaforge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps (Novaforge)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can align with your procurement timeline: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: Inconsistent response latencies and high per-token cost for interactive assistant across multiple products.
- Current stack: On-prem inference for core models + hybrid cloud for burst traffic (internal inference controller, S3 for logs).
- Goal: Reduce median token latency under 150ms for web interactions, cut per-token costs by ~30% at current scale, and centralize observability across deployment modes.

Success criteria you shared
- < 150ms median latency for 95% of user queries
- Clear cost savings vs current GPU spend (target: ~30%)
- SOC 2 + encryption-at-rest for logs and KV cache
- Ability to pin model versions and run canary rollouts

Key technical notes we captured
- You currently use Triton-backed serving for core models; interested in Redwood’s dedicated and private options for predictable throughput and data isolation.
- KV cache and prefix caching will be important to hit latency SLOs for your interactive flows.

Procurement framing / next steps
- Stakeholders: Ops (you), Procurement (Michael Lee, who Emma will introduce), Security (TBD).
- Timeline: you indicated a target decision window of 6–8 weeks to get pilot approval.
- Initial commercial guardrails: as a starting point, teams like yours typically pilot with a 3-month reserved/dedicated block + overage pricing for burst; ballpark TCV for a pilot ranges ~$75k–$150k depending on reserved capacity. We can tighten once we know capacity needs.

Attachments: I’ve attached the Novaforge security questionnaire and an initial ROI calc (ballpark) to help procurement.

Proposed next meetings
1) Technical deep-dive (45m) with your engineers — propose Thu 10/22 or Fri 10/23
2) Procurement & pricing sync (30m) with Michael + our CS/Commercial lead — propose week of 10/26

Can you confirm: 1) Michael’s email, 2) approximate pilot capacity (GPU hours or avg QPS) so we can tighten guardrails, and 3) whether SOC 2 Type II evidence will be required prior to pilot?

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachments: Novaforge_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, Initial_RoI_calc.xlsx
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@novaforge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps (Novaforge)

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap, this looks right. A few quick clarifications: 
- Michael Lee is our Procurement Manager (michael.lee@novaforge.com) — I’ve looped him on a separate email.
- Technical ask: our current peak QPS for the assistant flow is ~1,200 QPS, with 99th pct seq length ~140 tokens.
- Security: we do require SOC 2 Type II for production; for pilot we can accept SOC 2 in-process evidence + a runbook for data handling.
- Budget: pilot budget is constrained — we’d need to keep pilot TCV under $100k unless execs reprioritize.

We can do the technical deep-dive on Thu 10/22 at 11:00am PT. Procurement sync can be Tue 10/27 afternoon.

Couple of items for your team: please call out whether Redwood’s private (VPC/on-prem) option is needed for the pilot vs dedicated hosted capacity (we’re evaluating both). Also — can you confirm typical pilot contract length and whether there’s a trial discount?

Appreciate it — Emma
Emma Jones
Sr. Product Manager, AI Platform | Novaforge Inc.
emma.jones@novaforge.com

Hi Emma / Michael —

Great to meet you, Michael — welcome. To help procurement and security move quickly, here’s a short procurement framing from Redwood and initial commercial guardrails we typically propose for pilots: 

Procurement & security checklist (pilot)
- NDA in place (we can share a standard mutual NDA if needed)
- SOC 2: provide SOC 2 Type II report for hosted production; for pilot we can provide SOC 2 in-process evidence + our controls summary and a restricted-data runbook.
- Data handling: logs and KV caches can be configured to stay in your VPC for Private deployments; for Dedicated we offer tenant-level isolation and encryption at rest.
- SOW items: pilot scope, reserved capacity (GPU hours or vGPU count), onboarding timeline, success metrics (latency/cost), exit criteria.

Initial commercial guardrails (example)
- Pilot length: 90 days preferred to validate latency and cost (we can shorten to 30 days for a technical-only evaluation).
- Pricing: reserved pilot block + overage. Example pilot TCV (depends on capacity): $60k–$100k.
- Discounts: we can offer a pilot discount (typical 10%) and credit toward first committed term if you convert to Dedicated.

Next steps
1) Technical deep-dive Thu 10/22 11:00am PT (calendar invite to follow) — agenda: QPS profile, seq length distribution, model variants, caching strategy.
2) Procurement sync Tue 10/27 — we’ll bring commercial + security docs.
3) I’ll upload a redlined starter SOW and a DocuSign link for the NDA so procurement can review.

Action items for Novaforge
- Michael: confirm procurement members and any legal review constraints/timeline.
- Emma: confirm pilot capacity (GPU hours or avg QPS) — Emma already noted peak ~1,200 QPS.

FP: Deal is HF-2026-0042 (internal). I’ll have Monica prepare a starter SOW and share SOC2 artifacts for your security team.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Starter_SOW_template.docx (will be shared via Drive after internal review)

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & procurement framing (Novaforge)

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the clear framing. From a commercial standpoint I agree to the guardrails you proposed. For this pilot we can offer: 
- Pilot discount: 10% off pilot TCV (applies if Novaforge signs within 30 days of pilot start)
- Pilot TCV cap: we should target <= $100k based on the Prospect’s ask — we can tighten once Novaforge confirms reserved capacity.

Monica — can you draft a starter SOW (90-day pilot, success metrics, reserved block spec) and circulate to Michael for comment? I’ll join the procurement call on 10/27.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
